description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class LeaveRequestDaoTest for testing data access operations related to leave requests in the OrangeHRM system. It includes test cases for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting leave requests, as well as handling entitlement assignments and overlapping leave periods.

classes.name: LeaveRequestDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LeaveRequestDao data access object, covering methods like getLeaveById, getOverlappingLeave, saveLeaveRequest, changeLeaveStatus, and others, using a fixture-based approach.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, instantiates LeaveRequestDao, loads fixture data, and sets up mock DateTime helper service.

methods.name: testGetLeaveById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of leave by ID and verifies fields.

methods.name: testGetOverlappingLeaveMultipleFullDayLeave
methods.description: Tests retrieval of overlapping full-day leave periods within a large date range.

methods.name: testGetOverlappingLeaveInSameDay1
methods.description: Tests overlapping leave detection within the same day for a specific time interval.

methods.name: testGetTotalLeaveDuration
methods.description: Tests calculation of total leave duration for an employee on a specific date.

methods.name: testSaveLeaveRequestNewRequestNoEntitlement
methods.description: Tests saving a new leave request without entitlement assignments and verifies database persistence.

methods.name: testSaveLeaveRequestNewRequestWithEntitlement
methods.description: Tests saving a new leave request with entitlement assignments and verifies correct assignment.

methods.name: testSaveLeaveRequestNewRequestWithEntitlementChanges
methods.description: Tests saving a leave request with entitlement changes and verifies updates.

methods.name: testSaveLeaveRequestNewRequestWithEntitlementChangesAndTakenLeave
methods.description: Tests saving leave with entitlement changes and a leave marked as taken, verifying entitlement adjustments.

methods.name: testChangeLeaveStatusNoEntitlementChanges
methods.description: Tests changing leave status to canceled without entitlement changes.

methods.name: testChangeLeaveStatusNoEntitlementChangesRemoveLinked
methods.description: Tests changing leave status to canceled and removing entitlement links.

methods.name: testChangeLeaveStatusEntitlementChangesRemoveLinked
methods.description: Tests changing leave status to canceled with entitlement adjustments and linked entitlements removal.

methods.name: compareEntitlement
methods.description: Compares expected and actual LeaveEntitlement objects using assertions on each property.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestsByEmpNumberAndDateRange
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of leave requests filtered by employee number and date range, including verification of request fields and associated leaves.

methods.name: getAllLeaves
methods.description: Helper method to fetch all Leave entities from the database.

methods.name: testGetLeaves
methods.description: Tests retrieving leaves filtered by leave request IDs, with pagination via offset and limit, and verifies returned leave IDs.

methods.name: testGetLeavesCount
methods.description: Verifies the count of leaves matching specific search filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestsByLeaveRequestIds
methods.description: Checks retrieval of leave requests by a list of leave request IDs.

methods.name: testGetLeavesByLeaveIds
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of leaves by specific leave IDs, asserting membership correctness.

methods.name: testGetUsedLeaveTypeIdsByEmployee
methods.description: Verifies which leave type IDs are used by specific employees, including employees with no leaves and non-existent employee numbers.
